Compared with SKWINSPX skevent.cpp::ACTUATE_DOOR and all Firestaff owners. Live and GAME_LOAD candidate paths apply the source open/closed/intermediate action gates, store DoorBit09 as 1=open/0=close with source byte order, and reverse an already-moving door without queueing a duplicate step timer. Still partial: complete-chain preflight rejects creature-occupied doorways instead of running the source party/creature effects; party/creature damage and sound effects remain unimplemented.

Compared with SPX skevent.cpp::STEP_DOOR and all Firestaff owners. Each path now gates on DoorBit10 and follows the source-endian DoorBit09 direction, including a direction changed by ACTUATE_DOOR. Still partial: party/creature collision effects, damage, and sound remain unimplemented; occupied-door chains fail closed.

Compared with SPX skgame.cpp::ACTIVATE_ACTION_HAND. Firestaff validates a living in-party hero and hand range, then updates active hero/hand before redraw. It does not gate selection with IS_ITEM_HAND_ACTIVABLE, nor mirror glbSelectedHandAction/glbSelectedHand_2, glbSomeChampionPanelFlag, glbMagicalMapFlags, CHAMPION_SQUAD_RECOMPUTE_POSITION, UPDATE_RIGHT_PANEL, and REFRESH_PLAYER_STAT_DISP source effects. The source activability helper exists elsewhere but is not wired into this click path.

Compared with SPX skevent.cpp::ACTIVATE_ORNATE_ANIMATOR as reached by wall/floor mecha dispatch. Firestaff's live branches set ActiveStatus and ActuatorData, queue the 0x55 continuation and invoke the once-only relay. They omit the source SoundEffect gate, GDAT 0x88 lookup and activation noise queue.

Compared with SPX skevent.cpp::ACTIVATE_CONTINUOUS_ORNATE_ANIMATOR as reached by wall/floor mecha dispatch. Firestaff toggles OnceOnlyActuator, aligns phase, updates ActiveStatus/ActuatorData, schedules the delayed 0x59 stop and invokes the revert relay. It omits the source player-map light-check updates and TRY_ORNATE_NOISE call when animation starts; the narrow helper is not used by the live path.

Compared with SPX skcrture.cpp::ACTIVATE_CREATURE_KILLER. Firestaff has a 3x3 scan and action model, but both live wall/floor mecha constructors set creature_killer_cb to NULL, so the visitor's source creature lookup, type filter, destroy-command change and AI-state attack effects never execute. Bind source-owned creature access and mutation before claiming parity.

Compared with SPX skevent.cpp::ACTIVATE_INVERSE_FLAG. Firestaff now computes the global operation as (RevertEffect ? 3 : 0) + incoming ActionType, applies it to ActuatorData, then invokes with the once-only action override. It fails closed when the source global-word owner is unavailable or the operation is outside the supported source range; verify all live platform owners expose the same global table before claiming parity.

Compared with SPX skevent.cpp::ACTIVATE_TEST_FLAG. Firestaff now forwards only for the source RevertEffect/global-value/ActionType cases 0, 1 and 2, and uses the once-only action override for the forwarded actuator. It fails closed when the source global-word owner or flag index is unavailable; verify global-table ownership for each platform before claiming parity.
